info.title: Roman Bandurin — Projects Catalog Agent API
info.description: Describes the agent-readable surface of the root catalog at https://roman-bandurin.github.io/. Every operation is a plain GET of a static file served by GitHub Pages; there is no server-side endpoint and no state. Each project published under this domain keeps its own contract under its own path (for example /crypto/openapi.json) and is reachable from the catalog operations listed here.
